description: Northlight Studio automation rules. Edit this file to change behaviour; no rule is hard-coded in automation.js. Nothing is ever sent externally – alerts only go to the local outbox list.

rules.name: Create CRM lead from website enquiry
Create Help Desk ticket from website enquiry
Urgent enquiries become priority P1
rules.log: Ticket {{ticket.id}} raised to P1 because the message is urgent.

rules.name: Create outbox alert for urgent enquiries

actions.subject: URGENT enquiry {{ticket.id}} from {{name}}
actions.body: {{name}} ({{email}}) sent an urgent enquiry. Ticket {{ticket.id}} is P1. Message: {{message}}
